STMicroelectronics licenses for vendor/STM32F30x_StdPeriph_Driver and vendor/CMSIS_std

Part 1: SLA0044 Rev5 (February 2018), published by ST as "Ultimate Liberty
Software License Agreement". The file headers name the "MCD-ST Liberty SW
License Agreement V2". ST does not state that SLA0044 replaced that agreement.
What is known:
- ST publishes this exact text as SLA0044 Rev5 in https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeF4
  (file Projects/STM324xG_EVAL/Applications/LICENSE.md).
- Third-party notices pair the Liberty V2 name with this text: Xilinx
  systemctl-labtool (license/LICENSE_3RD_PARTY_HW_SERVER) and
  https://github.com/pvvx/STM32INA2xxPowerProfiler (LICENSE.ST).
- ST's user manual UM1581 (Figure 2, page 24) shows the library zip containing
  "MCD-ST Liberty SW License Agreement V2.pdf". An ST staff post of
  1 November 2013 on community.st.com ("Software license Liberty V2") says the
  agreement is attached; that attachment link now returns HTTP 404.
Not found: the text of "MCD-ST Liberty SW License Agreement V2.pdf".

Part 2: Software Package License Agreement SLA0048 Rev 6 (February 2026,
document dm00218346), linked from
https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stsw-stm32108.html together with
"Additional License Terms for STM32F30x/31x DSP and Standard Peripherals
Library" (Copyright 2021 STMicroelectronics). Annex 1 of those terms lists
STM32F30x_StdPeriph_Driver as "Proprietary" and "STM32F30x CMSIS" as
BSD-3-Clause (BSD text: vendor/CMSIS_std/LICENSE.txt).
